This page contains the portable R script ([`Code/replication_analysis.R`](Code/replication_analysis.R)) used to generate all tables, statistics, and figures in the [replication report](index.html).

## Requirements

* R ($\ge 4.1$) with `tidyverse`, `estimatr`, and `scales`
* Input dataset: `Data/butler_nickerson_clean.csv`

To reproduce all console outputs locally from the project root:

```bash
Rscript Code/replication_analysis.R
```

## Full Script (`Code/replication_analysis.R`)

```{r echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE, file="Code/replication_analysis.R"}
```
